text.aria-label: Title text 'Primary D10 (signed-MW six group), 2025-12 fold: a false load-shift of 15% of capacity up for 15 days is added to the power the lag inputs see (dashed blue). The target power (black) is unchanged, so a median that moves towards the dashed line is wrong. The shift runs from 30 Nov to 15 Dec; the plot starts at the first stored forecast.'
